description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping itself, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing copy of Su-Chi.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
 Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi's power.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
